channel.title: Press Information Bureau - India
channel.description: Official press releases from the Government of India

item.title: NCDRC orders refund to consumers for defective home appliances
item.description: The National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission directed XYZ Electronics to refund Rs. 2.5 crore to affected consumers who purchased defective washing machines between January 2023 and December 2024.

item.title: Consumer Protection Authority orders compensation for misleading advertisements
item.description: The Central Consumer Protection Authority has ordered ABC Foods Ltd to pay Rs. 50 lakh compensation to consumers affected by misleading health claims on their packaged juice products.

item.title: Appointment of new Secretary, Ministry of Consumer Affairs
item.description: Shri Rajesh Kumar has been appointed as the new Secretary of the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution.

item.title: National seminar on consumer rights awareness
item.description: A national seminar on consumer rights awareness will be held in New Delhi on July 25, 2026, organized by the Department of Consumer Affairs.

item.title: Consumer forum awards compensation to individual complainant in insurance dispute
item.description: The District Consumer Forum awarded Rs. 2 lakh compensation to Shri Ramesh Sharma for deficiency in service by National Insurance Company Ltd in settling his health insurance claim.
